summary: Equity Residential (EQR) and ERP Operating LP entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger with AvalonBay Communities (AVB) and subsidiary Canopy Merger Sub LLC. The filing describes an all-stock merger-of-equals, with the combined company to operate under a new name. No per-share price, premium, or deal value are stated. Both boards unanimously approved. The structure is a stock-for-stock merger via a subsidiary. Watch for shareholder votes, regulatory clearance, and the risk-arb spread given the stock consideration and lack of cash component.
